description: Client-side script for the 'Opening Invoice Creation Tool' form in ERPNext, handling setup, real-time progress updates, invoice creation, and UI updates.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initial setup for the form, including query filters and real-time event handlers.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the form, disables save, and sets up primary actions.

methods.name: setup_company_filters
methods.description: Sets query filters for company-related fields.

methods.name: company
methods.description: Handles changes to the company field, updates filters, and fetches related data.

methods.name: invoice_type
methods.description: Updates invoice rows based on selected invoice type.

methods.name: make_dashboard
methods.description: Creates a dashboard section showing opening invoice summaries.

methods.name: update_invoice_table
methods.description: Updates invoice table rows with default account and party type.
